main_text.p: timi Magni, in hæc verba: {a}Unum Saluator noster universalem voluit esse Ecclesiam, quæ esset partibus in multas ac diversas loca distributa sic, nno tamen Spiritu, id est divino consilio fungitur[?]. Idemque Theodoretus verba refert Alexandri, Episcopi Alexand. huiusmodi: {b}Confitemur unam & solam Ecclesiam universalem, quam non totius mundi oppugnatio posset subvertere, perpetuo victricem seditiosa impietatis adversarium dogmatum. Hæc ille.Theodor. hist. lib. 1. c 10.ibid. cap. 4.

Ita igitur docuerunt Græci Patres. Quum vero Græci Scriptores Catholicam matrem omnium nostrūm celebrent, num Romanam designant? Nihil minus. Orientales enim Ecclesiæ a Romana religionem ac fidem non acceperunt, sed Romanæ dederunt: nec quisquam Pontificiorum tantum unquam arrogare potuit, ut Romanam Ecclesiam diceret matrem Ecclesiarum in Oriente. Si autem Romana Ecclesia non sit illarum Ecclesiarum mater, profecto non est Catholica. Illæ enim Catholicam agnoscunt matrem suam. Nos vero eandem cum illis matrem agnoscimus Catholicam. Hactenus Græci; audiamus Latinos.
main_text.head: CAPUT VI.
Continet testimonia Latinorum Patrum, de Ecclesia Catholica, & de Ecclesia Romana.
main_text.p: Quatus[?] de Ecclesia Catholica sic disputat: {c}Ubi erit proprie Catholicæ nominis? Quumlib. 1.

page.notes: The right-hand page is cut off at the scan edge. Only the first letters of its lines are faintly visible, so those lines are marked illegible and the counts are estimates. The word "Quatus[?]" is a doubtful reading of the enlarged opening letter and the word after it. "fungitur[?]" is doubtful, and the first word "Unum" is uncertain, since the scan reads "Vnum" or "Vnam". The reference mark "c" beside "Ubi" and the bottom-left note "lib. 1." are faint. The word "Catholicæ" is also uncertain. Printed in the margin: "Theodor. hist. lib. 1. c 10." and "ibid. cap. 4." Some words in the body are blurred by staining.
